content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Building-systems contractor doing electrical, fire and life safety installation and maintenance for commercial and industrial buildings, similar to IES's end markets."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, surveying and planning consultancy billing professional labor, not electrical installation or building systems contracting."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced gas, electric line and fiber work for utilities and telecom operators, not building electrical and low-voltage systems."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Paving, highway and aggregate production for public roads, a heavy civil business with no electrical building work."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Telecom network construction for carriers and cable operators, outside plant work rather than building electrical systems."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Manufacturer of meters, test equipment, filters and aerospace parts, not a contractor installing systems for building owners."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Wholesale distributor of plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products, earning product margins rather than installation service revenue."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Heavy civil highway and water construction with owned quarries and asphalt plants, serving public agencies rather than building electrical work."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Building systems installation, maintenance and controls for commercial and institutional owners, closely matching IES's electrical and building services model."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Electrical, mechanical and plumbing contracting with recurring building service and prefabrication, closely matching IES's contracting and service mix."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Telecom, utility, clean energy and pipeline infrastructure construction, a different customer and work mix from building electrical systems."}]}
